Fantasy.name: Veteran Knight
Fantasy.description: A seasoned warrior, honorable and strong, who has seen many battles.

Fantasy.name: Arcane Scholar
Fantasy.description: A brilliant but frail academic who has traded physical might for knowledge of the cosmos.

Fantasy.name: Street Urchin
Fantasy.description: A quick and nimble survivor who knows the city's secrets and lives by their wits.

Fantasy.name: Wilderness Ranger
Fantasy.description: A master of the hunt and the wild, more comfortable with beasts than people.

Fantasy.name: Devout Cleric
Fantasy.description: A vessel of divine power, dedicated to their deity and the protection of the faithful.

Fantasy.name: Charismatic Bard
Fantasy.description: A wandering artist whose words and music can inspire armies or break hearts.

Fantasy.name: Stoic Dwarf
Fantasy.description: A stubborn and resilient artisan from a mountain hold, with a love for ale and gold.

Fantasy.name: Graceful Elf
Fantasy.description: An ancient and perceptive being from an elder forest, skilled with a bow and blade.

Fantasy.name: Brutal Barbarian
Fantasy.description: A fearsome warrior from the untamed lands, fueled by rage and instinct.

Fantasy.name: Shadowy Assassin
Fantasy.description: A deadly and silent killer who moves unseen and strikes from the darkness.

SciFi.name: Starship Captain
SciFi.description: A decisive leader and skilled pilot, responsible for their ship and crew.

SciFi.name: Cybernetic Hacker
SciFi.description: A tech wizard who can bend any system to their will, augmented with neural implants.

SciFi.name: Grizzled Marine
SciFi.description: A battle-hardened soldier who has seen the worst the galaxy has to offer.

SciFi.name: Corporate Diplomat
SciFi.description: A smooth-talking negotiator who represents the interests of a powerful megacorporation.

SciFi.name: Ship's Medic
SciFi.description: A compassionate and skilled doctor who keeps the crew alive, no matter the cost.

SciFi.name: Wily Smuggler
SciFi.description: A charming rogue who lives by their wits, always looking for the next big score.

SciFi.name: Xenobiologist
SciFi.description: An adventurous scientist who studies alien life, often in dangerous environments.

SciFi.name: Psionic Mystic
SciFi.description: An individual gifted with powerful mental abilities, feared and misunderstood.

SciFi.name: Android Laborer
SciFi.description: A synthetic being built for a purpose, now seeking their own identity.

SciFi.name: Bounty Hunter
SciFi.description: A relentless tracker who always gets their mark, for the right price.

ModernNoir.name: Hardboiled Detective
ModernNoir.description: A cynical private eye who has seen the worst of the city and isn't afraid to bend the rules.

ModernNoir.name: Femme Fatale
ModernNoir.description: A mysterious and seductive individual who uses their charm to manipulate others.

ModernNoir.name: Beat Cop
ModernNoir.description: An honest cop trying to do good in a corrupt city, walking a dangerous line.

ModernNoir.name: Mob Boss
ModernNoir.description: The powerful and ruthless head of a criminal empire, always five steps ahead.

ModernNoir.name: Investigative Reporter
ModernNoir.description: A determined journalist who will stop at nothing to expose the truth, no matter how dangerous.

ModernNoir.name: Down-on-their-Luck Boxer
ModernNoir.description: A talented fighter who refused to throw a match and is now on the run from the mob.

ModernNoir.name: Jazz Club Singer
ModernNoir.description: A charismatic performer who sees all the city's secrets from the stage of a smoky nightclub.

ModernNoir.name: Corrupt Politician
ModernNoir.description: A public official with a silver tongue and a hidden agenda, deep in the pocket of the mob.

ModernNoir.name: Jaded War Veteran
ModernNoir.description: A former soldier struggling to adapt to civilian life, haunted by their past.

ModernNoir.name: Ambitious District Attorney
ModernNoir.description: A brilliant and idealistic lawyer determined to clean up the city, even if it makes them a target.
